items.title: Should Raised 2026 Outlook Require Action From Quanta Services (PWR) Investors?
items.summary: Quanta Services recently raised its quarterly cash dividend to US$0.13 per share, or US$0.52 on an annualized basis, an increase of about 18% from the payment made in October 2026. The higher dividend will be paid to shareholders of record as of January 4, 2027.
